title: PowerPoint on desktop: reference a PowerPoint file when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft has not documented an admin setting governing this capability is too broad. Microsoft documents connected-experience privacy controls that disable Copilot in PowerPoint on desktop; the narrower gap is a switch specific to Reference file. The roadmap facts, licensing requirement and both control rows are supported.

claims.claim: The desktop change lets users reference PowerPoint file content when creating a presentation with Agent Mode.
claims.quote: You can now reference the content of a PowerPoint file when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

claims.quote:
If you turn off connected experiences that analyze your content on devices in your organization, Microsoft Copilot features won't be available to your users in the following apps:

claims.fix: In Why it matters, replace the sentence with: 'Microsoft has not stated a default specifically for Reference file or documented a switch specific to it. Broader connected-experience privacy controls can disable Copilot in PowerPoint on current Windows and Mac apps.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy. In the first Open questions bullet, remove 'and does any admin setting turn it off?' so it asks only 'Is Reference file on by default?'
